verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented API or warehouse export for Abacum's model outputs. Warehouse and ERP connections are described only as inbound data sources, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404. The only egress path is the Excel connector, a spreadsheet add-in for finance users rather than a programmatic export into a warehouse or internal tool, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull model outputs (metrics, forecasts, scenario results) into a warehouse or internal tool through a documented export or API
